name: Silver Sphere
description: One of seven magical spheres about a foot across, of silver and platinum. Valuable enough to buy entry to the upper ranks of society. Together on their pedestals they hold the forest's shadow at bay.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Stone Torch of St. Rylan
recharge: Be blessed in the Temple of St. Rylan.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Purple Goblin Berserker Mushrooms
description: All attacks are _enhanced_ for 2 rounds; then the user takes a Fatigue.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Porcelain Mask
description: Your face becomes a perfect match for someone you have seen in the last 24 hours.
recharge: Whoever you copied swears an oath of loyalty to you.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Pebble of the Raging River
description: Hurled at the ground, it makes a 10ft cube of water on the spot.
recharge: Submerge it in a river for a year and a day.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Clay Cup of Statera
description: Drinking from it lets you sense evil within a mile, for an hour.
recharge: Make a new cup as well crafted as this one.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Gauntlet of the Pilgrim
description: A target you raise your palm to cannot come any closer, though it can still attack.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes
